title: Track Guide Road Atlanta Short UPDATED Toytoa GR86 iRacing

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: End of left wall, 35% brake pressure, trail to inside curb
corners.line: Track out over white line, turn-in to inside curb
corners.exit: Accelerate, car should walk out to left side of track
corners.mistakes: Going into grass means early throttle

corners.braking: Before white line, 70% brake pressure, trail to inside curb
corners.line: Take a lot of inside curb
corners.exit: Accelerate, car should walk out to left side of track
corners.mistakes: Getting 1x on inside means cutting too much

corners.label: T7
corners.braking: break at the first white line, 90% brake pressure, trail brake to inside curb
corners.exit: accelerate, flat out to start finish line
corners.mistakes: lifting for turn eight costs time, underdriving turn eight costs time

corners.label: T8
corners.exit: use the outside for exit speed
corners.mistakes: lifting for turn eight costs time, underdriving turn eight costs time

general_tips: Stay left side of track after T2, take every curb up to T5
Before T5, be left side of track, turn-in to inside curb
keep right side of track to turn 7 for shortest route in qualifying
turn seven is a good place for overtaking
